notes: Lead search in the tab row (press / to jump to it). Emails now send in the background through your mailbox, with your signature, confirmed in Sent Items (no more Drafts, no Outlook window), and only confirmed sends are counted. Bounced addresses get a warning icon. New email types (Quote follow-up, Reconnect, Seasonal check-in, Referred to you, Last check-in) plus extra versions, grammar fixes, learning from your edits ('Yours' version), draggable composer, no counts beside version numbers. Contacts sort by clicking Name/Phone/Mobile/Email. Load updates appear as notifications at the top. Go back works from SCANR. Contact delete moves activities one by one and asks if some can't move.
